06328
Life in the age of science and technology
김강배
Nature is the place of precious life for humans. Man cannot exist outside of nature. This does not mean that nature is always a beautiful, cozy and comfortable haven. Rather, nature is a wild and dangerous wild for humans. Physically weak humans developed the wisdom of cooperation and division of labor and various skills to survive in the wild. This has resulted in an equal, free, democratic and safe human civilization. We are producing generous food, using energy to improve productivity, and using the information to create an amazing information world. Through science, we can understand nature and our own identity, and through technology, we can live a more human life. There is a problem. As the population grows rapidly, human life becomes difficult and serious problems arise in the environment. But you can't give up science and technology and go back to the wild and wild. Active efforts are needed to embrace the rational scientific spirit of honestly recognizing experiences and evidence, and to develop the ability to ethically identify the side effects of new technologies.
06301
Substance Addiction and Human Behavior
Drugs that induce substance addiction in modern society include not only alcohol, nicotine, and narcotics, but also psychotropic drugs that are legally prescribed, chocolates that infants and adolescents like, drinks instead of modern meals, Coffee caffeine is also included  These substances induce sudden changes in human emotions, thoughts, judgment, cognition and behavior, and distort common ones.  Substances that induce addiction in this way naturally enter our society in general and cause serious problems for modern humanism.  This leads to a vicious circle where the substance is poisoned again while receiving excessive stress  Therefore, through this course, we will study the concept, characteristics, symptoms, and causes of substance addiction and learn about the effects of substances on humans and brain changes. Substances that directly or indirectly affect human behavior by studying methods to prevent and treat substance addiction by systematically learning about substances that directly or indirectly affect human behavior Learn about preventive bapbon by learning the features, reactions, steps, etc.

Korean Language for Employment 1
이수연
This introductory, practice-oriented course is designed for international students to systematically develop the foundational Korean communication skills necessary for entering the Korean job market. The curriculum focuses on the initial stages of job preparation, covering essential business-related vocabulary, workplace etiquette, basic interview expressions, and the fundamental principles of writing resumes and cover letters.
Students will gain essential knowledge for the Korean corporate environment, including an understanding of Korean workplace culture, organizational structures, appropriate language for hierarchical relationships, basic business manners, and the fundamentals of handling phone calls and writing professional emails. Additionally, the course aims to cultivate basic job-performance skills, such as understanding job postings, preparing answers for common interview questions, and following and reporting on simple work-related instructions.
This course serves as the foundation for the subsequent "Korean Language for Employment 2," establishing a step-by-step, systematic approach to mastering professional Korean and building the linguistic groundwork required for the entire job preparation process.

06558
Teaching Korean pronunciation for Foreigners
When learning a new language, the most basic thing is to learn its pronunciation system. From the perspective of a communication approach, pronunciation may be less important than other language elements such as grammar or vocabulary. However, no matter how much language knowledge you have, if your pronunciation is poor in accuracy and fluency, there are many chances that you will not be able to communicate effectively. Also, it is not an exaggeration to say that Korean learners have very strong demands on improving their speaking ability, and that the beginning of speaking begins with correct pronunciation. In this course, students will diagnose their own Korean pronunciation ability based on their understanding of the Korean pronunciation system and pronunciation rules, and improve their Korean pronunciation ability and teaching ability by practicing pronunciation and exploring the principles of education.

Introduction to Administration

03790
Quantitative Methods in Administration
표선영
This course provides an overview of statistical methods and hands-on application to managerial decision-making in public administration. Understanding statistical analysis and being able to work with data are important competencies of professionalism in public administration. Course topics include program evaluation, data collection and measurement in public administration, descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, processes for selecting statistical tests and assessment of statistical assumptions, measures of association and other bivariate statistics, index variable construction, regression analysis, and an overview of selected other statistical and quantitative methods applied to problems of public administration. Students get hands-on experience through the use of SPSS. Recognizing the social, political, and economic context of data collection, analysis, and reporting practices in the public sector, this course also discusses the ethics of data analysis and information technology policy and management.

Public Enterprise
이선영
The course aims at understanding the political, socio-economic, managerial issues of public enterprise and providing comparative analysis of public enterprise policy between South Korea and other countries. The contents of the course include the locus and rationale of public enterprise in a mixed economy, types of public enterprise, laws for governing public enterprise, management of public enterprise in organization, labor, budgeting accounting, and price policy, the control and performance evaluation of public enterprise, and privatization of public enterprise.

Fiscal Administration
김성찬
The course aims to addresses two broad and interrelated questions: the first is descriptive: How do governments acquire and spend money? The second is normative: How should governments and spend money? To answer the questions, the course develops how the government budgeting process works, where it doesn't work, and how it can be improved. The contents of the course provide government budgeting processes, cost-benefit analysis in government project, an overview of government accounting and procurement, taxation in budgeting, and so on. Also it focuses the future of government budgeting on how government budgeting might best be reformed.

07258
Organizational Behavior and Bahavioral Public Administration
이희주
Humans are social animals and cannot live alone. They belong to organizations, whether small or large, formal or informal. From the family unit to schools, clubs, gatherings, workplaces, various communities, societies, nations, and the global village, humans form relationships within different contexts. Within these organizations, individuals interact with other members and are influenced by various factors within the organization, shaping their thoughts and behaviors.

This course explores the thoughts and behaviors of members within organizations, how they interact with others, and form relationships. It helps students understand various emotional, attitudinal, and behavioral issues and problems that arise within organizations. The course provides an academic foundation for effectively transforming the behavior of organizational members and increasing satisfaction in various organizational settings, such as workplaces. Furthermore, it attempts to approach various organizational behavior phenomena caused by human limited rationality and irrational decision-making from the perspectives of behavioral public administration and behavioral economics.
01954

Capstone Design for Administrative Studies

Especially, attentions will be devoted to the policies or programs of the central government, local governments and public bodies because they play markedly significant roles in producing public goods and services. Accordingly, by the end of the course, students will be able to achieve the ability to assess and make a policy, in terms of accountability, quality and effectiveness, from their own perspectives.
06632
Public Administration Internship ProgramⅠ
Pre-professional work/field experience for public administration. 
At the end of the course the
student will be able to demonstrate the following.
1. Cognitive complexity – the ability to take in information and see the connections amongst a data set through critical thinking, intellectual flexibility, and reflective judgment.
2. Knowledge acquisition and application – the ability to seek knowledge and apply
   it to different arenas.
a. Students will learn to be self-directed learners
b. Students will apply classroom theory to the work setting
3. Humanitarianism – the ability to understand and appreciate diversity in humanity
   and be sensitive to the needs of others. This will be measured through
a. Discussions of interpersonal communications and civic responsibilities
b. Comments from specialist faculty on e-journal submissions
c. Critiques of other students’ presentations.
4. Interpersonal and intrapersonal competence – the ability to develop selfconfidence, identity, and a sense of civic responsibility.
a. This will be measured through taking the Strong inventory and MBTI, the
   subsequent analysis of the results of these inventories, and other value
   clarification activities.
5. Practical competence – the ability to manage one’s personal affairs and become
   self-sufficient economically.
You are expected to work at the placement five full days per week during regular office hours. There will be monthly report seminars and final report presentation.

Organic Chemistry Lab.
이기연
Fundumental concepts relating to carbon compounds with emphasis on structural theory and nature of chemical bonding, stereochemistry, reaction mechanisms, and spectroscopic, physical, and chemical properties of the principal classes of carbon compounds. The theory practice of laboratory operations.
00102
Polymer Chemistry
Modern concepts in synthetic polymer chemistry will be introduced. Chain and step-growth polymerization, inorganic polymers, reactions and properties of polymers. Kinetics of polymerization will also be discussed.
03386
Inorganic Chemistry2
This is the second semester of a two-semester inorganic chemistry for chemistry majors.  In second semester, topics will cover atomic structures, chemical bonds, inorganic synstheses, molecular structures and chemical properties of major examples of inorganic compounds.
03385
Physical Chemistry2
이종현
Macroscopic phenomena will be described with the thermodynamic scope to get understanding about the kinetics and equilibria.
00267
Physical Chemistry3
Physical chemistry 3 invloves quantum mechanics to describe the nature of chemical bonds in a single molecule.  Additionally, basic principles of rotation, vibration, and electronic spectroscopy  will be introduced to understand the physical analyses of molecular structures.
04560
Reaction kinetics
Reaction kinetics includes basic concepts in thermodynamic molecular movements and chemical reactions involving the enzyme, polymer and photochemical reactions. This material will have been covered in a typical microscopic molecular dynamics.
03382
Analytical Chemistry2
안병관
This is the second semester of a two-semester analytical chemistry sequence intended for chemistry major. Topics covered this semester will include: acid-base titration, redox titration, basic electrochemistry.
05669
Research on Material Chemistry 2
이종현, 김중한, 한동훈
This is the continuous course of Research on Material Chemistry  1. Students make their own research plan by the guidance of supervisor. Student can learn basic experimental principles and techniques. At the end of semester, each student have to present their experimental results and submit final research report. Also, students may report professor their own report one or two times per month.
05067
Organic Synthesis
This course presents reactivity principles of organic molecules. Topics of this course include carbon-carbon bond formation, cationic, anionic, radical, and carbene intermediates. Strategies for assembling complex organic molecules are presented.
03381
Organic Chemistry2
Fundamentals of Aromatic and heterocyclic compounds will be studied and the advanced organic synthetic methods and the properties of organic compounds will be treated in this lecture.
00669
Organic Chemistry4
Reaction mechanisms, reaction kinetics, linear free relationships, structure-reactivity correlation, transition state theory, and molecular orbital theory.
06126
Electrochemistry
- The course will afford the Fundamentals of electrochemistry including the principles of redox reactions and the electron and  ion tranfer process.
- it also qives the modern electrochemical control methods via the voltage charge, and current detection in the course of redox reactions.
Accounting
01179
서동수
신철
장려요
외국인 학생 전용 분반
00111
Management Accounting
송유정
Studies conceptual frameworks and methods to assure that activities of an organization are planned and controlled efficiently based on cost and other information toward the accomplishment of organizational objectives. The course emphasizes how to design and implement an effective accounting system which will guide the organization for continuous improvements.
00910
Intermediate Accounting1
This course is to further students, understanding of financial information beyond the principles of Accounting. It covers transaction analysis, preparation and reporting of financial statements, and analysis of the deployment of assets in revenue generating processes.
장현석
07251
Advanced Enterpise Resource Planning
The course is designed for students who have taken Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) to understand the extended and various modules of the SAP S/4 HANA system.   
It aims to enhance their understanding of overall business processes and teach them how to support management decision-making by analyzing SAP S/4 HANA-based data from multiple dimension
00097
Advanced Accounting
안성희
Price level change accounting, Equity method, Accounting for branch operation, Branch accounting, Consolidated financial statements, Business combinations, Foreign currency translations and other specialized accounting topics.
07474
Financial and Insurance Accounting
Financial and Insurance Accounting
This course is intended for students aspiring to pursue careers in the financial and insurance industries. Its objective is to strengthen students’ ability to analyze the financial statements and financial conditions of firms in these sectors, thereby enhancing their practical competencies for entering the financial domain of specific industries. It is also expected to improve students’ competitiveness in in-depth interviews related to the financial and insurance industries during the job recruitment process.
In this course, students will select an industry of interest—particularly financial institutions—and engage in advanced learning of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) currently applied in practice. Students will also form teams to conduct systematic analyses of specific issues and financial conditions arising in their chosen industry or company, utilizing accounting knowledge, industry analysis, and financial analysis methodologies acquired throughout their studies.
04537
Financial Instruments and the Accounting for Financial Instruments
Students can understand transaction flow and economic effects of financial instruments in the domestic and international financial market through this course.  In the class, this course offers accounting treatments for financial instruments with various cases and invitation of experts in the financial market. It is of great help for the students who have interet in the financial institution.
06151
Valuation
김종일
This course covers the various valuation topics including valution method, strengths and weaknesses of each method, process, detailed process, major application fied. In addition, it also provides various valuation theory and cases.
04652
Corporate Income Taxes Law
박희우
This course provides the difference between the corporate accounting standard and the corporate income taxation, the basic structure of the taxation, the principle tax codes, and the computation of corporate income tax.
06200
Practices of Tax Accounting
박경득
This course aims to brush upon the basic knowledge on Intermediate Accounting, Individual Tax, Value-added Tax and Corporate Tax Law and to apply for the real situations through lots of problems and exercises. Students can combine the theories and practices all together and prepare themselves for the various decision-making circumstances.
05910
Individual Income Tax Law
This course provides the basic concepts and the theory of the individual income taxes law to understand the tax practices.
This course contains numerous clarifying examples including individual tax filing adaptable to such approach.
04289
Cost Accounting
강성조
This course presents the concept, factor and estimates for costing accounting based on basic accounting knowledge. Therefore, this course gives guideline for the costing process  of manufacturing.
07252
Financial BigData Analytics
This course aims to enhance data analysis skills in the fields of finance and accounting by teaching basic statistics, databases, and Python programming.    
It also helps improve computer auditing skills through data analysis using Fraudit Software.  
Additionally, this course covers the theory and provides practical exercises required for obtaining the Financial Big Data Analyst certification
05642
Financial Accounting
This course provides various topics of assets, liabilities, equity, special issues of financial accounting based on Accounting Principle. Students can enhance ability to study Intermediate Accounting. 
The level of this study is the middle course between Accounting Principle and Intermediate Accounting.
장진녕
04654
ERP
This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Enterprise Resource Planning concepts, the process-centered organization, integration of Enterprise Systems, and how ERP supports global business enterprises.   The course focuses on the Enterprise Resource Planning concept, the basic principles of Enterprise System software and the basic functional and technical issues in applying Enterprise Systems software for decision-making using the  leading ERP packaged software.
04291
Introduction to Tax Law
00911
Intermediate Accounting2
한학주
The course provides a solid theoretical foundation for financial reporting, and is designed for students who have taken Intermediate Financial Accounting 1. It covers bonds, long-term debts, leases, income taxes, investments, and capital transactions.
02134
Accounting Information System
New theories and techniques regarding planning, implementing and evaluating accounting information system.
06520
Major in Accounting career seminar
This course aims to help students to explore their own desired career paths in the fields of financial accounting, managerial accounting, tax accounting, and information technology in accounting major.
To achieve this purpose, professors in accounting department provide lectures on a specific accounting subject and career direction in accounting and then alumni who is working in accounting fields to share their experiences.
Finally, students prepare a resume at graduation and present it in class for future career.
06881
Accounting Seminar
This class is a subject to learn IT, financial statement utilization, internal control, ESG, etc., which are issues of the times, with accounting education under the constantly changing accounting environment. This course contributes to increasing students' knowledge convergence thinking and nurturing talents that meet social needs
06074
Accounting  capstone design project 2
This capstone design course brings students experiences  integrating across the accounting curriculum and offers a unique opportunity  to practice the transformative method thereby solving unstructured problems.  Students will produce a project proposal related to contemporary accounting issues and challenges. While completing a capstone project that requires students to apply what they  learn to a real-world situation, senior accounting students can prepare to  enter the business environment as accounting professionals.
06611
Accounting internship program 1
The purpose of the long term internship is to help the students increase practical ability and job adaptability at companies. The students should submit the contents of the job practice periodically, which would be evaluated by the professor. The students would learn problem solving ability. They would also have opportunity finding their job that would meet their interest and values.

[CUK] Course List for 2026 FALL Semester_ as of 06 AUG 2026_For your reference
① #K
""Class Language"" : A type means 100% conducted in foreign languages, B type means 75% conducted in foreign languages(Korean-Foreign language blended/mixed class), 
    if there is nothing mentioned regarding course language, class will be conducted in Korean in general.
▶ This information is
as of 6 August 2026
,
and
there can be changes(updates) in course details
such as conducted language. Therefore, please check the CUK portal(Trinity) once again before you register.

② #J ""Day+Time(Classroom)"" : Number written beside day means as below. 
   -
1(9:00-9:50), 2(10:00-10:50), 3(11:00-11:50), 4(12:00-12:50), 5(13:00-13:50), 6(14:00-14:50), 7(15:00-15:50), 8(16:00-16:50), 9(17:00-17:50), 10(18:00-18:50)
- Example : ""WED2-4"" means class is on Wednesday from 10:00 to 12:50

③
No matter which major you are registered, you are able to take classes of other majors
, however, there are some classes which has prerequisites or limits on backgrounds of students taking that class, in that case, you have to meet the requirements.

④ Courses with less than 20 students enrolled will be closed, when the course you have chosen is cancelled, you may have to select alternative courses.
⑤
Dates for Course Registration: will be announced soon.

Why
are there so many classes for 1 subject?
Some courses have multiple sections because they are in high demand.
-For example, the Marketing course(00241) may have several sections (such as Section 05, Section 06, etc.). Although they are the same course, the class times and instructors are different. You only need to register for one section.
- International students should make sure to check whether the section is taught in English and confirm the language of instruction before registering.
